name: clock-out
description: Keeps CronCreate schedules alive: records every session's jobs, renews expiring ones, revives stopped sessions, and shows them all in /clock-out.

usageWidget.title: Usage widget (Windows)
usageWidget.description: Windows service: show the usage status bar widget (off = service runs without a window)

alignPing.title: Align 5-hour window (Windows)
alignPing.description: Windows service: send a tiny haiku call at 08:xx and 13:xx on weekdays so the 5-hour window resets at 13:00 / 18:00

expandAt.title: Daily revive time
expandAt.description: Service: time of day (HH:mm) to revive every stopped session that still has jobs

weekdaysOnly.title: Weekdays only
weekdaysOnly.description: Service: only do the expandAt revive on weekdays

reviveLeadMinutes.title: Revive lead (minutes)
reviveLeadMinutes.description: Service: revive a stopped session this many minutes before its next job

expiryLeadHours.title: Re-register lead (hours)
expiryLeadHours.description: Re-register a recurring job this many hours before Claude Code's 7-day expiry

legacyTranscriptScan.title: Scan transcripts (legacy)
legacyTranscriptScan.description: Service: also read ~/.claude/projects transcripts for sessions that never loaded this plugin
